title: Bind AC1018 named-block SORTENTSTABLE refusal to its owning dictionary graph

independentReader.scope: Corroborates the BLOCK_HEADER, DICTIONARY, SORTENTSTABLE identities and their parent/extension/entry relationships.

authority.title: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference — SORTENTSTABLE
authority.relevantRule: The DXF group-code 330 owner is currently only *MODEL_SPACE or *PAPER_SPACE.

decision.reason: SORTENTSTABLE 0x2CE is owned by the named-block extension dictionary 0x2CD, not by *MODEL_SPACE or *PAPER_SPACE. Reassigning or omitting the table would alter the observed owner graph without an eligible semantic mapping.
decision.outputQualification: Neither 0x2CD nor 0x2CE is qualified for this source graph. Keep the parent DICTIONARY and its sole child refused together; do not emit a partial parent body.
decision.unblockCondition: An authoritative DXF route or independent semantic evidence must establish how this named-block source table is represented while preserving owner meaning. Until then the evidence cannot promote a support claim.

limitations: This receipt is a source-graph and schema-scope decision; it contains no local DXF output or fresh-readback proof.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added to the repository.
The whole AC1018 source remains independently blocked by the invalid non-shape empty-name STYLE 0xDF and other open P4 gates.
